records.text: Lou Taylor tried to place Courtney Love and Lindsay Lohan into conservatorships
records.speaker: Brett Cooper

appearances.snippet: Just a couple of years ago, the New Yorker reported that she also tried to place Courtney Love and Lindsay Lohan into conservatorships

verification.notes: The New Yorker reported two related but materially different allegations: Michael Lohan said Lou Taylor raised the possibility of a conservatorship for Lindsay Lohan, while Courtney Love said Taylor tried to wrest control over her family estate. Taylor denied trying to put Spears, Lohan, or Love into conservatorships. The episode statement accurately cites the article but overstates the Courtney Love allegation by recasting estate control as a conservatorship attempt.
